台指期周五（2日）夜盤持續上攻，盤中一度大漲逾300點、最高衝上48993點，進逼 49000 點大關。台北時間今晚8時30分美國將公布9月非農就業報告，該項數據為全球市場關注焦點，更是聯準會（Fed）評估後續利率政策方向的關鍵指標。

華爾街機構預估，美國9月非農就業人數將增加8.4萬人，失業率則維持在4.1%。雖然新增就業人數增幅較先前有所趨緩，但失業率數據仍符合充分就業水準，顯示勞動市場基本面依舊穩健。

市場交易員的態度則比華爾街經濟學家更為樂觀。預測平台Kalshi最新數據顯示，市場預測9月新增就業突破9萬人的機率近60%，突破10萬人的機率也達 50%。由於8月非農就業人數意外強勢激增16.2 萬人，加上前幾個月數據獲得上修，為市場信心提供支撐，使得今晚公布9月非農的報告更受矚目。

聯準會官員將藉由本次就業數據，進一步確認美國勞動力市場的韌性。在Fed促進充分就業與維持物價穩定的雙重目標下，先前因勞動市場穩定，政策重心主要放在壓制通膨表現。

若周五公布的非農就業報告符合預期，將證實就業市場在貸款利率走升與中東衝突推升燃油價格等壓力下，依然具備強勁韌性。若非農數據顯著優於預期，聯準會升息的機率恐將隨之上升；反之，若就業市場表現意外疲弱，聯準會內部的鷹派立場預計將受到壓制。

news.Title: Should You Forget Tesla and Buy These 3 Robotics Stocks Instead?
news.Content:
If you're interested in robotics as a real business, not just a fancy, broad, science fiction-esque idea, I don't think investors need Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) to get that exposure during the next few years.

Tesla has talked openly about robots and automation. However, most of its actual results are still to come, and the company's revenue and earnings come from selling cars, energy products, and software tied to those businesses. The robot narrative is more promise than near‑term reality in my opinion, and that makes it hard to judge how much of today's valuation you're really paying for robotics versus everything else.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

There's another way to play this theme. You can own companies that already sell robots , automation platforms, and machine‑vision technology to factories and warehouses, offering new robotics capabilities and artificial intelligence (AI) to established customer bases. That's what Teradyne (NASDAQ: TER), Zebra Technologies (NASDAQ: ZBRA), and Rockwell Automation (NYSE: ROK) are doing right now. To me, these companies are more likely to drive measurable growth in robotics during the next couple of years than Tesla's still‑developing humanoid projects.

1. Teradyne: Robots where work actually happens

Teradyne describes itself as a provider of automated test equipment and advanced robotics, and it has been busy turning that robotics label into real deployments. In 2026, the company highlighted its Teradyne Robotics unit, unveiling a wide range of "production‑ready physical AI applications" at the Automate trade show and expanding a partnership with Flex to scale intelligent automation across global manufacturing. It also opened a new office in India to deepen its support for semiconductor and electronics manufacturers, hinting at more robots and automation being installed in one of the world's fastest‑growing manufacturing regions.

Teradyne's robots are already tied into real manufacturing workflows, and its presence is growing in regions where new factories are being built. When buying this stock, keep in mind that the shares have already climbed about 200% during the past year, while some planned insider selling could add pressure.

If you're averaging into Teradyne, it may make more sense to wait for dips rather than go all in at current prices. The company continues to benefit from strong demand for semiconductor testing equipment, especially as AI and memory chips continue to drive growth.

Story Continues

2. Zebra: Turning machine vision into frontline automation

Zebra Technologies has built a portfolio focused on digitizing and automating workflows for frontline workers, and this year it took a big step to sharpen that focus. The company sold its Robotics Automation business to Skild AI, taking cash and an equity stake to concentrate its investment in higher‑growth areas such as radio‑frequency identification (RFID), machine vision, and artificial intelligence on the shop floor. At the same time, Zebra launched a new machine‑vision camera and showcased an ecosystem of automation solutions at Automate 2026 that connect physical assets, workers, and data across the supply chain.

In plain terms, Zebra is turning robots from a stand-alone product into part of a broader intelligent operations story. This story is where cameras, scanners, and software guide whatever automation a customer uses. That approach can scale faster than betting everything on a single robot body.

This company is a strong buy because it's leaning into the growing push toward automation, with its hardware, software, and data-capture tools connecting physical operations and digital workflows. The business is also seeing stronger demand across manufacturing and healthcare.

3. Rockwell: AI plus autonomous robots inside factories

Rockwell Automation frames itself as the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation, and robotics falls within that broader mission. In 2026, it announced plans to demonstrate at the INTERPHEX biotech conference how life‑sciences manufacturers are integrating AI‑driven analytics, autonomous mobile robots, and digital manufacturing platforms into real production environments, according to R&D World.

Rockwell has a strong foothold in industrial automation, with sticky customers, high margins, and solid growth as factories invest more in robotics and AI. Rockwell is already expanding its robotics and AI-enabled automation business, but as a cyclical industrial company, its results still depend on broader factory spending.

news.Title: 台股創高難帶動匯價　新台幣收31.83元週線翻貶
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北2026年10月2日電）台股延續漲勢，今天再創收盤新高，但未能拉動匯率勁揚，新台幣兌美元今天盤中續於31.9元價位偏弱整理，央行尾盤調節之下，終場小幅翻揚，收盤收31.83元，升1.2分，匯價連3升，台北及元太外匯市場總成交金額收斂至21.91億美元。

台股今天資金持續流向被動元件、記憶體及ABF載板族群，終場上漲122.25點，收在48475.74點，續創收盤新高。三大法人同步買超，外資呈現連3買，但加碼幅度有限，今天僅買超26.21億元，難以為匯價提供有力支撐。

新台幣兌美元今天以31.87元開盤後，匯價延續貶勢，迅速跌破31.9元、最低觸及31.935元，儘管出口商於31.9元上方進場拋匯，但量能有限，新台幣開低走低，直到尾盤央行進場調節後，小幅翻揚，終場以小升作收。

外匯交易員直言，近期新台幣漲勢主要都由熱錢大舉匯入所帶動，近日股匯脫鉤，主因是台股上漲，但外資匯入動能有限，在此同時，美元指數強勢表態，新台幣匯價因而於31.9元附近徘徊，難以突破。

新台幣今天同步收週線，本週累計貶值5分或0.16%，週線翻貶。

外匯交易員指出，美伊戰事持續僵持，國際油價處在高檔，增添通膨壓力，市場普遍認為美國聯準會年底前仍將升息，美元指數、美債殖利率雙升，令亞幣表現受抑；在此情境下，新台幣缺乏足夠動能突破區間，下週估於31.7元至32元區間偏弱整理。

另外，外匯交易員表示，美國非農就業數據今晚出爐，如果就業數據保有韌性，可能推升市場對聯準會後續升息的預期，後續通膨數據表現將更顯關鍵。

news.Title: 華邦電4工人傳工安意外 公司：已送醫治療、將配合後續調查
news.Content:
記憶體廠華邦電(2344-TW)現正積極擴充產能，今(2)日11時於南科高雄路竹廠傳出重大工安意外，傳出共有4名工人在進行化學管路施工時，不慎遭強酸噴濺，造成多處灼傷，公司表示，事件發生後公司已立即啟動應變機制，傷者已送醫治療，目前生命徵象均穩定，事件發生詳細原因仍在調查中，公司將全力協助傷者並配合後續調查。

據了解，華邦電的外包商人員在廠區內進行化學管路施工，遭到俗稱「化骨水」的氫氟酸與硝酸混合化學廢液噴濺，造成4名工人身體多處灼傷，分別緊急送往義大醫院及高雄榮總搶救。4名傷者中有3名外包商員工、1名華邦電員工，當中年紀最小僅22歲。

4名傷者在現場接受初步處置後，由救護人員協助送醫進一步檢查與治療，當時均保持清醒，暫無生命危險，至於實際傷勢程度及後續治療情況，仍待醫療院所進一步評估。事故發生後，高雄市勞工檢查相關單位等主管機關已介入調查，將釐清事故發生的確切原因，以及當時外包廠商施工程序、危害性化學物質管理、現場安全防護措施及相關作業是否符合規定。

news.Title: 南亞科沒去雲林轉屏東！ 張麗善說話了
news.Content:
台塑集團旗下記憶體大廠南亞科（2408）設廠選址出現變化！原先評估進駐雲林虎尾產業園區，如今確定轉向南部科學園區屏東園區，國科會1日召開科學園區審議會，通過南亞科屏東分公司進駐案，投資金額並未公開。南亞科未來將投入先進半導體3D晶圓封裝及測試業務。對此，雲林縣政府表達遺憾，縣長張麗善更質疑虎尾園區農地變更歷經2年多、7次送審仍未完成，中央審查標準有待說明。

雲林苦等2年多 虎尾園區7度送審仍未完成

雲林縣政府表示，虎尾產業園區自2024年3月至2026年9月歷經7次送審，農業用地變更仍未獲同意。今年9月農業部並要求先釐清是否報請行政院認定為「重大投資案」或「重大建設」，才能進一步確認開發必要性。縣府指出，自2026年3月起曾與南亞科至少召開4次正式會議，就企業投資方向、園區條件及配套措施進行討論，因此此次投資方向轉變，地方感到遺憾。

張麗善喊「雲林不缺水電地人才」 盼中央說明審查標準

雲林縣政府表示，隨半導體及相關產業快速發展，產業用地需求持續增加，中科虎尾園區用地已趨飽和。位於園區南側約300公尺、面積約29.75公頃的虎尾產業園區，鄰近既有產業聚落，具區位優勢，可作為半導體及相關廠商設廠腹地，強化產業群聚效益。

張麗善表示，雲林具備水、電、土地及人才等產業發展條件，盼中央能就對虎尾園區的審查標準與程序進一步說明。縣府並指出，虎尾產業園區預定地約29.75公頃，鄰近既有中科虎尾園區，相關環評及用水、用電規劃已完成，盼中央在兼顧農業與產業發展下，加速相關程序。

（封面圖／翻攝《張麗善》粉專）

news.Title: 川普稱台積電將在美投資5,000億美元 經濟部：尊重企業爭取國際商機
news.Content:
美國總統川普透露「偉大的台灣晶片公司」計劃在美投資5,000億美元，外界關注台積電赴美投資情形。經濟部回應，在全球供應鏈韌性需求下，政府尊重企業因應國際客戶爭取更大國際商機及全球多元佈局。台積電目前公開宣布赴美投資累積金額為2,650億美元，相關投資計畫以公司向外界說明為宜。

川普於《時代雜誌》（TIME） 專訪中透露，「偉大的台灣晶片公司」計劃在美投資5,000億美元。

經濟部對此回應，台灣半導體產業的實力強勁，在全球佔據關鍵地位，在全球供應鏈韌性需求下，政府尊重企業因應國際客戶爭取更大國際商機及全球多元佈局。

經濟部表示，台積電目前公開宣布赴美投資累積金額為2,650億美元，相關投資計畫以公司向外界說明為宜，經濟部持續與台積電保持溝通及互動，協助企業海內外佈局及拓展國際市場。

經濟部進一步指出，台美已經簽訂台美投資MOU，強化台美雙方戰略夥伴關係，加強產業合作，政府會針對台灣企業赴美投資強化協助。

經濟部強調，在布局全球的同時，台灣仍是全球最重要的半導體生產及研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會根留台灣，政府將盡力協助企業在台擴大投資，確保台灣核心優勢。

news.Title: 不只科技廠跟台積電 建商5.9億買鳳凰城商辦
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者傅儀文,攝影陳柏誠

AI不僅帶動科技股市值狂飆，電子廠大舉擴產也出現罕見的「搶廠潮」！日月光今年已經斥資近500億購置廠房，大立光更是七度加碼掃貨，二家獵地破15筆。但不只台灣，就連上市建商達麗建設，近期最新宣布加碼佈局美國市場，鎖定的就是台積電所在的亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

台積電美國亞利桑那新廠持續推進，讓美國這片荒漠之土蛻變為完整的半導體生態系，也讓台灣上市建商達麗建設加碼布局美國市場。達麗建設宣布，子公司以1860萬美元、約新台幣5.9億元，取得鳳凰城區域基地面積超過8700坪的優質商辦，正式將美國版圖延伸到全美半導體與高科技的產業重鎮。

達麗建設副總經理 廖政雄：「之前已經去考察過很多次了，我們發現不只有台積電，它的上游跟中下游廠商，其實都已經過去了，那在鳳凰城這邊的話，住宅的需求當然是有，但是廠辦的供給其實比較少。」

相較於傳統純住宅開發案的銷售循環周期，達麗建設反而聚焦商業不動產與收益型不動產投資。而回到國內，科技擴產帶動的置產需求也正在發生，甚至就連科技大廠都出現罕見的「搶廠潮」。

像是日月光為今年的購廠大戶，在桃園、苗栗、南投、台南、高雄八度買廠，投入金額高達482億元；大立光則是把火力集中在台中，七度購廠，總計今年已經砸下近81億元，取得超過1萬8千坪的廠房空間。

信義全球資產顧問發展部經理 林建勛：「這些在交易的買方，他們其實挑選就是，現在既有廠房的為主，因為他們的訂單都非常的急迫，所以基本上，他們希望可以即戰力」。他進一步指出，第二點就是，他們在挑選位置的時候，他們會盡可能挑選，以他們現址比較近，比如車程大概20分鐘內，這樣的標的為主。」

畢竟隨著AI需求持續升溫，對企業來說，誰能搶先取得合適廠房，誰就能掌握擴產量能、搶占市場先機，也替這波房市廠辦需求增添另一道市場熱度。（記者 傅儀文、陳柏誠／台北採訪報導）

news.Content:

news.Title: Micron is about to do something that would surprise most 'Magnificent 7' investors
news.Content:

But keep Micron's quarter in context.

news.Title: Teradyne Expands Memory Test Portfolio: Can It Beat KLAC & COHU?
news.Content:
Teradyne TER is benefiting from rising demand for advanced memory testing, supported by strong high-bandwidth memory (HBM), DRAM, and NAND requirements tied to artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. The company's expanding memory test portfolio, led by Magnum platforms, strengthens its competitive positioning in the broader semiconductor test-equipment market against KLA KLAC and Cohu COHU. Teradyne noted that Magnum testers combine memory and logic-test capabilities, providing memory manufacturers with attractive swing-tool flexibility.

Memory has emerged as an important growth engine for Teradyne. In the second quarter of 2026, memory revenues reached a record $212 million, marking the third consecutive quarter above $200 million. Growth was driven by robust demand for HBM and DRAM test solutions, as well as a recovery in NAND. Memory book-to-bill exceeded 2, indicating solid demand visibility. Management expects the 2026 memory test TAM to be more than 40% higher than 2025, supported by HBM, DRAM and NAND growth.

Further expanding its memory test portfolio, Teradyne recently launched Magnum E2, a next-generation high-speed memory test system designed to address growing test requirements driven by artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. Built on the company's Near-DUT Test architecture, Magnum E2 supports advanced DRAM and flash interfaces, including LPDDR6, DDR6, GDDR7 and NAND flash. The platform offers higher parallelism, improved signal integrity and support for NRZ, PAM3 and PAM4 signaling. It also combines memory and logic testing on a single platform, helping manufacturers simplify testing while supporting qualification through high-volume production.

Rising memory bit production and technology transitions such as HBM3 to HBM4, DDR5 to DDR6 and next-generation flash should further increase test requirements, supporting Teradyne's ability to expand its memory-testing footprint. Management expects memory revenues to grow in the second half compared to the first half.

How Competitors Fare Against TER

Teradyne is facing stiff competition from companies such as KLA and Cohu. Both companies are expanding their footprint in the semiconductor industry.

KLA is benefiting from strong semiconductor demand, driven by accelerating investments in AI infrastructure, leading-edge foundry/logic, memory and advanced packaging. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, revenues reached a record $3.66 billion, increasing 15% year over year and 7% sequentially. Management attributed the performance to rising AI infrastructure investments and greater process-control intensity across memory and advanced packaging.

Cohu's improving semiconductor test demand and expanding exposure to AI computing, HBM inspection and software remain noteworthy. Growth in AI workloads is driving demand for HBM, and Cohu has established a position in this market through its Neon inspection platform. Cohu is extending its Neon inspection platform across HBM3, HBM4 and HBM4E production while investing in HBM5 and later generations.

Story Continues

news.Title: Salesforce Expands AI Bundles: Will Higher Adoption Boost ARR?
news.Content:
Salesforce, Inc. CRM is expanding its AI bundles, aiming to make it easier for customers to adopt its growing suite of artificial intelligence (AI) tools. The company is continuously introducing premium bundles that combine new AI capabilities with its existing applications. Earlier in September 2026, it introduced Core, Advanced and Max editions for Agentforce Sales, Service and Industries, bundling AI, Slack, Tableau Next, security and support into a single purchase.

The early results suggest that its bundled approach could help lift recurring revenues. In the second quarter of fiscal 2027, it revealed that bookings from Agentforce One Edition and Agentforce for Apps more than doubled sequentially. Salesforce also stated premium Slack upgrades have tripled since Slackbot launched. These trends indicate that customers are moving from AI trials toward broader purchases.

The impact is already visible in Salesforce's AI business. Agentforce ARR (annual recurring revenues) topped $1.5 billion in the second quarter, up more than 240% year over year. Combined Agentforce and Data 360 ARR reached nearly $3.9 billion, rising more than 210%. Meanwhile, customers generated 3.2 billion Agentic Work Units in the quarter, up 97% sequentially, pointing to stronger use of AI agents.

Higher adoption could support Salesforce in multiple ways. Bundles can increase spending from existing customers by adding AI features to current contracts. Deeper use of Agentforce, Slack and Data 360 can make Salesforce's platform more valuable and expand its recurring revenue base.

Still, AI growth has yet to materially change the company's overall growth rate. Second-quarter revenues rose 11% year over year to $11.35 billion, while management expects fiscal 2027 revenue growth of 11%-12%. Expanding AI bundles are a promising growth lever. If adoption remains strong, they could gradually accelerate Salesforce's recurring revenue growth.

Salesforce Rivals Intensify AI Bundle Competition

Salesforce is not the only enterprise software company using bundled AI products to increase customer spending. Its major competitors, Microsoft Corporation MSFT and Oracle Corporation ORCL, are also focusing on a similar approach.

Microsoft is expanding Microsoft 365 Copilot across its software ecosystem. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot surpassed 30 million paid seats, with net seat additions more than doubling sequentially and the number of customers deploying above 50,000 seats growing more than sevenfold year over year. Microsoft's Dynamics 365 revenues also increased 13% year over year in the fourth quarter, showing continued demand for its business applications.

Story Continues

Oracle is taking a similar approach by adding AI capabilities to its cloud applications. The company is moving beyond traditional per-seat licensing to consumption-based token bundles. This approach lets enterprises pre-purchase agentic AI capacity in a predictable, scalable way across application tiers.

In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Oracle's Cloud Applications revenues reached $4.1 billion, up 10% year over year, while total cloud revenues jumped 47% to $9.9 billion. Oracle's AI-focused cloud strategy is also driving strong demand across its broader platform.

Salesforce's Price Performance, Valuation and Estimates

Salesforce shares have declined 10.6% year to date, while the Zacks Internet – Software industry has risen 9.2%.

Salesforce YTD Price Return Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

From a valuation standpoint, CRM trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 14.65, significantly below the industry's average of 30.59.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for Salesforce's fiscal 2027 earnings implies a year-over-year increase of approximately 33.5%, while estimates for fiscal 2028 indicate a 5% decline. Estimates for fiscal 2027 and 2028 earnings have been revised upward in the past 30 days.

news.Title: 台積電、鴻海、聯發科都跌！台股反而再創收盤新高48,475點　三大法人同步買超95億元
news.Content:
台股今天（2日）出現罕見的「權值股休息、指數照樣創高」走勢。台積電、鴻海、聯發科、台達電等大型權值股同步收黑，加權指數早盤也一度翻黑，不過被動元件、ABF載板、光通訊及部分中小型電子股接棒上攻，終場上漲122.25點，收在48,475.74點，再度刷新歷史收盤新高，成交金額8981.74億元。

早盤一度跌破48,300點　尾盤重新站上48,400

台股今天以48,390.65點開出，小漲37.16點，盤中一度因大型權值股出現獲利了結而翻黑，最低下探48,205.81點。

不過中小型電子族群接棒後，買盤重新回流，最高來到48,491.62點，距離盤中歷史高點48,601.53點僅約110點，終場收48,475.74點，漲幅0.25%。本週累計上漲451.14點，週線連續第三週收紅。

台積電跌10元　四大電子權值股同步收黑

最特殊的是，今天並不是靠台積電硬拉指數。

台積電終場下跌10元、收2500元，跌幅0.4%；聯發科下跌30元，收4950元；鴻海下跌3元，收251元；台達電下跌20元，收1885元。廣達也下跌2元，收332元。

幾檔大型電子權值股同時整理，大盤卻仍然刷新收盤紀錄，顯示今天市場資金並沒有全面退出，而是明顯往其他產業及中小型股移動。

ABF載板、被動元件接棒　多檔個股大漲

今天盤面最明顯的接棒族群之一是ABF載板。

欣興上漲超過7%，景碩上漲近4%，南電也走高；臻鼎-KY更直接攻上漲停。被動元件族群同樣強勢，包括華新科等多檔個股亮燈漲停，光通訊、PCB及矽晶圓族群也有資金進場。

櫃買市場漲勢更強，櫃買指數上漲1.94%，也反映今天市場主力並非集中在大型權值股，而是擴散到中小型股票。

三大法人同步買超95.57億元　外資連3天站買方

news.Title: 名師操盤》CPO、記憶體強勢表態！專家曝「5檔接棒黑馬」大戶暗中吃貨
news.Content:
中秋連假後首個交易日（9月29日），市場接連迎來地緣政治與科技警訊兩大重磅利空：美伊緊張局勢再度升溫，以及微軟創辦人比爾蓋茲對AI潛在風險示警。然而，面對雙重利空夾擊，大盤當日僅回檔392點，這不就是多頭市場的特性嗎？

大戶籌碼集中迎布局窗口

利空鈍化正是典型多頭行情的特徵之一，拉回往往吸引買盤進駐。加權指數隨後拉出連三紅，儘管目前尚未突破前波高點48,601點，但權值龍頭台積電(2330)今日率先發動攻勢，股價突破前高2,510元，在指標股帶頭衝鋒下，市場普遍看好大盤後續有望跟進挑戰歷史新高。

今天台積電的領先創高就已經預告了未來加權也會創高的指標效應，所以我在這可以大膽斷定，如果六日期間國際股市沒出現什麼重大利空，下周一大盤前高48601點就會突破，而在突破之前，你應該要觀察的事就是還有什麼股票可以趁勢布局？

隨著指標股率先表態，市場目光正轉向尋找下一批具備成長空間與適合逢低承接的優質標的。

▍CPO族群(高速傳輸、光通訊)

大家高度關注的CPO族群，先前因漲多而迎來一波健康修正。這段時間經過充分的「洗盤沉澱」與「籌碼換手」，不堅定的短線浮額已被有效清洗，大戶籌碼集中度顯著提升，目前正是逢低分批布局的絕佳窗口。

如：AI算力高速傳輸需求帶動產品組合質變的聯鈞(3450)、矽光子產品占比正式跨過70%的聯亞(3081)與邁入高階光互連應用的核心主力前鼎(4098)。

四大驅動引擎引爆卡位潮

▍記憶體

另一個值得重點鎖定的就是記憶體族群！過去一段時間股價飽受壓抑、經過反覆震盪整理，市場最悲觀的預期已全數反應，正是資金伺機卡位的絕佳時機。

擁有四大核心驅動：CUBE邊緣 AI 架構、國際大廠轉單外溢、集團持股綜效，以及利基型記憶體報價回升的華邦電(2344)。

擺脫美光授權依賴，全面轉向自主1B製程且16Gb DDR5 已成功量產並進入放量期的南亞科(2408)。

「行情總在半信半疑中成長、憧憬中毀滅。」當前市場正處於「半信半疑」的起漲擴展期，後續仍具備可觀的上漲空間。投資人務必把握這波黃金布局期，切莫等到市場一片樂觀時才盲目追高，恐將錯失良機。

news.Title: Ranking the "Magnificent Seven" From Most to Least Attractive, Based on Projected Cash Flow
news.Content:
Since early August, all three of Wall Street's major stock indexes have catapulted to record highs. Although artificial intelligence (AI) has been the clear catalyst behind this move, it's the " Magnificent Seven " that have lifted the stock market to new heights. The Magnificent Seven consists of (in descending market cap):

Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA)

Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL)

Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG)

Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT)

Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN)

Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META)

Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA)

These trillion-dollar businesses are leaders within their respective industries, but this doesn't mean they're all worth buying . While there's a laundry list of ways to value stocks, arguably none work better for the Magnificent Seven than projected cash flow.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

Ranking the Magnificent Seven by their projected cash flow

The price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio is the go-to for most investors when quickly evaluating a public company. While the traditional P/E ratio works great for mature businesses, it struggles to tell the full story for high-growth stocks.

More importantly, all of the Magnificent Seven companies reinvest a substantial percentage of their cash flow into high-growth initiatives. This makes cash flow and projected cash flow, not the P/E ratio, the best measure to determine if a Magnificent Seven stock is a bargain or bloated.

According to Wall Street's consensus cash-flow-per-share estimates for 2027, as of Sept. 25, here's how the Magnificent Seven rank from most (i.e., cheapest) to least (i.e., priciest) attractive:

Amazon : 10.91 times estimated forward-year cash flow

Meta Platforms : 11.84

Microsoft : 15.39

Nvidia : 15.6

Alphabet : 16.11

Apple : 30.48

Tesla : 80.2

Based solely on cash flow, Elon Musk's Tesla and iPhone maker Apple are the antithesis of a bargain. By comparison, dual-industry leader Amazon and social media titan Meta Platforms stand out as genuine bargains amid the second-priciest stock market in history.

Amazon and Meta remain attractive amid a historically pricey stock market

For the first time in several months, Amazon has leapfrogged Mark Zuckerberg's Meta to become the most attractive Magnificent Seven stock by future cash flow. Whereas Amazon closed out every year of the 2010s at 23 to 37 times its reported cash flow, shares can now be purchased for less than 11 times next year's projected cash flow.

Story Continues

Amazon is a beast on two fronts. While most investors know it's the kingpin of e-commerce, they might not realize that Amazon Web Services (AWS) is also the global No. 1 cloud infrastructure services platform by total spend. Since Amazon integrated generative AI and large language model solutions into AWS, sales growth for this segment has reaccelerated.

What's more, AWS is a considerably higher-margin operating segment than online retail sales. As it grows into a larger piece of the pie, Amazon's cash flow can grow at a much faster pace than sales.

Meanwhile, Meta's shares have surged following the early September release of its Muse personal AI assistant. Wall Street has been wondering how Meta would capitalize on its aggressive AI spending, and Muse offers a small taste of that.

But don't overlook Meta's foundational social media platforms. Lost amid the AI hype is the 3.6 billion daily active people Meta's family of apps attracted, on average, in June. No other social media platforms come close to this figure, providing Zuckerberg's company with impressive ad-pricing power.

news.Content:
台股今天(2日)續創收盤新高，終場上漲122.25點，收48475.74點，週線連3紅。法人指出，近期指數維持高檔，但隨著大型權值股漲勢暫歇，市場資金也開始轉向中小型題材股。不過成交量能未同步放大，成為後續攻高的重要觀察指標。

台股2日盤中一度下挫逾百點，不過在被動元件、PCB、矽晶圓等族群接力撐盤下，指數震盪走高，終場收在48475.74點，續站48000點關卡，上漲122.25點，再創收盤新高，成交金額新台幣8981.74億元。週線上漲451.14點，連3週收紅。

觀察籌碼表現，三大法人買超95.57億元，其中外資買超26.22億元，投信買超49.1億元，自營商買超20.26億元。

新台幣兌美元今天震盪走升，早盤以31.87元開出，終場收在31.83元，台北外匯市場成交金額15.42億美元。

法人指出，大型權值股休兵，盤面個股跌多漲少，顯示資金仍集中於特定族群，尚未全面擴散，後續可觀察載板、PCB族群能否延續漲勢，以及權值股整理後能否再度接棒。

台新投顧總經理黃文清指出，台股本波自低點反彈，期間雖面臨美國利率政策不確定性，但基本面仍維持穩健，市場信心未受明顯影響，成為支撐指數持續走高的主要動能。2日台股指數雖再創新高，但成交金額僅8,900多億元，並未同創新高。由於近期量能未有效放大，稍嫌美中不足，成交量能成後市重要觀察指標，他說：『(原音)反應在盤面上就是這個量沒有有效放大，也是這波(指數)上來的主要癥結點，如果說成交量放大的話，那這個氣勢會更強，相對來說會才更有機會。但是因為(成交)量小的情況之下，我們現在的做法都還是看說是不是在這個震盪的過程當中，指數碎步往上攻堅。』

黃文清說，若量能無法有效放大，短線大型權值股大漲機率有限，盤面表現可能轉向中小型股，特別是7月回檔幅度較大的族群，有機會成為資金輪動焦點，建議投資人留意矽晶圓、光通訊、被動元件及散熱等族群。

news.Title: 記憶體大廠爆工安意外！ 4人遭「化骨水」灼傷 公司回應了
news.Content:
記憶體大廠華邦電（2344）高雄路竹廠區今（2）日驚傳工安意外！廠內外包商人員進行化學管路施工時，疑似遭俗稱「化骨水」的氫氟酸、硝酸混合化學廢液噴濺，造成4人多處灼傷，其中最年輕僅22歲。高雄市消防局上午11時21分接獲通報，立即出動14車、34人前往搶救，傷者經現場處置後，分別送往義大醫院及高雄榮總治療。對此，公司也回應了。

化學管路施工出意外 4人不同部位灼傷

南科高雄園區華邦電路竹廠區，當時外包商人員正在進行化學管路施工，過程中不慎遭氫氟酸及硝酸混合廢液噴濺。4名傷者包括22歲李姓男子、48歲許姓男子、29歲陳姓女子，以及36歲華邦電劉姓男員工。李男臉部、雙手、胸部及背部受傷；許男下半身灼傷；陳女右前臂受傷；劉男則為右前臂受傷。消防人員到場時，4人意識均清楚，隨即送醫接受治療。

「化骨水」具高度危險性 詳細原因待調查

氫氟酸具有高度腐蝕性，若人體接觸，除可能造成皮膚表層灼傷外，氟離子還可能穿透皮膚及組織，與體內鈣、鎂離子結合，嚴重時可能造成低血鈣、組織壞死及其他傷害，因此俗稱「化骨水」。至於此次事故的實際發生原因及責任歸屬，仍待相關單位進一步調查釐清。

對此，華邦電表示，公司獲報後已立即啟動應變機制，傷者也依程序送醫治療，目前事件原因仍在釐清中，公司將全力協助傷者治療，並配合後續調查。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: Got $1,000? 2 Growth Stocks Building the Software Backbone of Artificial Intelligence.
news.Content:
Companies that provide infrastructure for artificial intelligence (AI) are getting a lot of attention right now because tech companies are expected to spend an estimated $1.3 trillion on AI infrastructure next year alone.

And while that's certainly fueling share price gains for some companies, the main driver of demand for such hardware is the advancement of AI software and models.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Two growth stocks that are at the forefront of AI software are Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL). Here's why it's worth putting $1,000 toward these stocks right now.

Microsoft's early AI lead is already paying off

Microsoft was an early investor in OpenAI and benefited from early access to ChatGPT and the ability to integrate the chatbot into many of its business software products. And although Microsoft doesn't have the same exclusivity with ChatGPT as it once did, it is a leading AI software company more than ever.

The latest example of this is the company's new Copilot app, which is an AI hub to help workers and consumers be more productive. Copilot can be downloaded to your desktop and includes an AI agent called Autopilot, Code for programming, Cowork for getting tasks done, and AI-powered Office apps all in one place. Microsoft calls it "your new OS for work."

The company is betting that it can build AI services on top of its solid enterprise software foundation. Even before the new Copilot app was launched, Microsoft already had 30 million paid Copilot subscribers, a 50% increase from just a few months earlier.

Copilot is a crucial new piece of the company's expanding AI menu, which includes its increasingly important Azure AI cloud computing business. By offering more advanced AI software to its customers, management will likely not only increase its paid Copilot subscriptions but also its AI cloud sales.

Many of its business customers use Azure for their cloud needs because it integrates easily with their existing software. In its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended June 30, Azure AI cloud revenue reached an annual run rate of $100 billion. Reaching that milestone means that Microsoft AI services are resonating with customers and that they are already a success.

Alphabet's AI models and leading software

Story Continues

Alphabet is in a similar position as the company integrates more AI tools into its popular software. The company's YouTube, Chrome browser, Search tool, and Workspace apps have all been centered around the technology.

The one benefit Alphabet may have over Microsoft is that Google has its own frontier AI model in Gemini, allowing it to build a proprietary AI system from the ground up for its products.

And there's already plenty of evidence that Gemini is paying off. Chief Executive Officer Sundar Pichai recently said that nearly 90% of Fortune 100 companies use Gemini Enterprise, a suite of software that includes AI-powered Workspace apps, Google Cloud features, and agentic capabilities.

The company said that millions of users, including Intel and PepsiCo , are employing Gemini Enterprise to automate their workflows and build AI agents. This usage is helping to boost Google Cloud sales, with revenue rising 82% in the second quarter to nearly $25 billion.

Alphabet is also making money from Gemini by selling access to Apple for that company's new Siri AI. Gemini is the foundational model for Apple's new service, and Alphabet is reportedly receiving $1 billion annually as part of the deal.

The combination of Alphabet integrating Gemini into its own services, increasing cloud sales, and growing revenue from licensing parts of it to Apple shows just how far-reaching the company's AI software strategy is.

Both are great long-term AI stocks

Both Microsoft and Alphabet are already firmly established software companies, and both are proving that they can benefit from the new AI era, rather than be disrupted. That's not easy, and investors should view their current success in this sector as a sign that they will likely continue to play leading roles in AI for years to come.

What's more, Alphabet has a trailing price-to-earnings ratio (P/E) of less than 18, and Microsoft's P/E is about 28, both of which are considerably lower than the tech sector average of 34. Which means putting $1,000 toward these AI software stocks right now is not only a smart long-term bet but also a relatively good deal.

news.Title: 英特爾急追！陸行之曝：這次台積電「學乖了」
news.Content:
台積電與英特爾在晶圓代工領域競爭激烈，知名半導體分析師陸行之表示，台積電在面對英特爾的晶圓代工布局時，態度似乎更加審慎，不再輕易提供過多產能，避免讓英特爾取得額外資源後，進一步擴大晶圓代工事業，形成潛在競爭壓力。

陸行之在臉書發文指出，近期從產業鏈獲得的消息顯示，台積電對英特爾的產能合作更加謹慎，過去若提供較多產能，可能反而讓英特爾有更多資源投入晶圓代工市場，因此台積電如今不輕易「加碼」，希望避免養大潛在競爭對手。

另一方面，台積電正與艾司摩爾、三星合作，推進下一世代High NA EUV（高數值孔徑極紫外光）相關技術，包括光罩尺寸的擴大，但目前並未邀請英特爾參與。陸行之認為，台積電對三星的競爭威脅相對沒有那麼在意，反而更加關注英特爾的技術進展。

陸行之指出，雖然英特爾18A製程目前仍與台積電3奈米製程存在差距，但英特爾在先進封裝領域的EMIB技術，近期在協助Google TPU相關產品方面已有進展，因此仍值得台積電持續觀察，換句話說，台積電目前不只關注製程技術，也密切留意英特爾在先進封裝及AI晶片供應鏈上的發展。

目前，台積電在全球晶圓代工市場占據主導地位，市占率高達72.5%，相較之下，英特爾持續推進18A、14A等先進製程，力拚擴大外部晶圓代工業務。

news.Title: 《韓股》買盤回流，KOSPI重返7000點
news.Content:

news.Title: President Donald Trump's Investment Team Sold Up to $25 Million in 2 Foundational AI Stocks in July
news.Content:
Some of the savviest billionaire money managers on Wall Street make hundreds of trades per quarter. But this doesn't even come close to matching the sheer number of trades undertaken by President Donald Trump's independent, third-party investment team since his second non-consecutive term began.

According to required U.S. Office of Government Ethics filings, Trump's financial disclosures list approximately 28,700 trades since January 2025, including 1,156 new trades in July 2026. While many of these trades are well below $1 million, two disclosed sales stand out: Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), each ranging from $5,000,001 to $25,000,000.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

President Trump's independent, third-party investment team completed 1,156 trades in July. Image source: Official White House Photo by Daniel Torok.

Amazon and Microsoft are foundational AI stocks

There's no hotter trend on Wall Street than artificial intelligence (AI) . Empowering software and systems with the tools needed to make split-second, autonomous decisions is a game-changing technology for most industries around the globe, with multitrillion-dollar potential.

While most investors have been fawning over AI hardware companies and taking advantage of the insatiable enterprise demand for graphics processing units, high-bandwidth memory, storage solutions, and rack servers, Amazon and Microsoft have established themselves as leaders in AI applications.

Before AI became the greatest thing since sliced bread for investors, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft's Azure were the world's No.'s 1 and 2 cloud infrastructure services platforms by total spend. Since generative AI and large language model capabilities were integrated into AWS and Azure, sales growth for both segments has rapidly accelerated.

AWS logged 37% sales growth in the June-ended quarter, representing its fastest revenue growth in 18 quarters. Meanwhile, Azure's sales growth jumped to 43% in Microsoft's fiscal fourth quarter (ending June 30).

These high-margin platforms, coupled with Amazon and Microsoft spending a small fortune to build out their AI infrastructure, have been foundational to the AI revolution.

Image source: Getty Images.

Trump's investment team just dumped Amazon and Microsoft stocks

Story Continues

With both companies performing so well, you might be wondering why Donald Trump's independent, third-party investing team sold large dollar amounts of each. Profit-taking is likely part of the answer, but perhaps not all of it.

The president's trades are reportedly driven by automated direct-indexing computer models. This allows for rapid-fire trading and the ability to take profits off the table quickly. But there may be more to this than just profit-taking.

History shows that every game-changing innovation since (and including) the advent and proliferation of the internet in the mid-1990s has navigated a bubble-bursting event. These bubbles form because investors persistently overestimate the pace of adoption and/or optimization of game-changing technologies. While AI has been rapidly adopted, we're likely years away from businesses -- even Amazon and Microsoft -- optimizing AI solutions to maximize sales and profits.

Additionally, stock market valuations are through the roof, courtesy of the AI build-out. While Amazon and Microsoft are, respectively, cheaper than other "Magnificent Seven" stocks, both would probably take it on the chin if the second-priciest stock market in history came back to Earth.

news.Title: Bull of the Day: Onto Innovation (ONTO)
news.Content:
Onto Innovation (ONTO) is a leading provider of process control, metrology, and inspection solutions for the global semiconductor industry. Headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, the company was formed in October 2019 through a merger of equals between Nanometrics Incorporated and Rudolph Technologies.

Today, Onto Innovation develops advanced hardware and AI-enabled software that allow semiconductor manufacturers to measure, analyze, and detect defects on silicon wafers and advanced packages, ensuring high yield and reliability in chip fabrication.

Target Markets & Product Strategy

Onto Innovation operates at the critical intersection of front-end semiconductor fabrication and back-end advanced packaging. Its solutions address several core markets...

Advanced Packaging & 2.5D/3D Logic: As chipmakers hit the physical limits of Moore's Law, multi-die architectures (chiplets) have become essential. Onto's inspection platforms ensure the integrity of interconnects in complex packages.

High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM): Crucial for AI accelerators, HBM requires precise metrology to align vertically stacked DRAM layers.

Specialty Devices & Silicon Photonics: The company provides film thickness and critical dimension (CD) metrology for RF devices, power electronics, and photonics used in optical networking.

Advanced Nodes: Onto delivers integrated metrology that allows customers to measure process variations directly on the die, improving yield in sub-5nm manufacturing.

Key Growth Drivers

The explosive demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure is Onto Innovation's primary catalyst. Traditional optical metrology is being pushed to its limits, creating distinct tailwinds for the company...

The AI Packaging Boom: Onto is a direct beneficiary of the rapid expansion in AI GPU production. The company's advanced packaging revenue has reached all-time highs, driven by demand for 2.5D logic (such as TSMC's CoWoS architecture) and high-bandwidth memory.

Dragonfly G5 Platform Ramping: Launched to address complex packaging inspection, the Dragonfly G5 platform has seen rapid adoption. Anticipated demand for the G5 is projecting over 50% growth through 2026 as customers pull forward orders to secure capacity for AI chip production.

Hybrid Metrology & AI: Onto is integrating AI-driven software to automate defect classification, pairing optical metrology with X-ray data to solve complex measurement challenges in next-generation memory and logic.

Customers & Strategic Partnerships

Onto Innovation serves the world's most advanced semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and memory manufacturers...

Tier-1 Foundry & Memory Customers: While equipment suppliers maintain strict confidentiality regarding specific order flows, Onto's process control platforms are deeply embedded in the supply chains of the industry's heavyweights, including TSMC (TSM), Intel, and Samsung. The company's recent surge is closely tied to the massive capacity build-outs by foundries to support AI chip designers.

Rigaku Holdings Corporation: In August 2026, Onto completed a $710 million strategic investment for a 27% equity stake in Rigaku, a leading provider of X-ray technologies. This transformational partnership targets the estimated $1 billion market for hybrid metrology, combining Onto's AI software and optical metrology with Rigaku's X-ray solutions (such as CD-SAXS) to deliver next-generation process control for advanced logic and V-NAND.

Why ONTO Tops the Zacks Rank

Onto Innovation has demonstrated robust fundamental execution, capitalizing on the semiconductor upcycle in 2026. The company delivered a strong Q2 report on August 6, including revenue of $343.1 million -- representing a 35.3% year-over-year increase -- and shares gapped up 14% the following day as analysts raised estimates and price targets.

The full year EPS consensus jumped 13% from $7.11 to $8.04, representing 63% annual growth vs 2025. And next year vaulted 17% from $10 to $11.72, for a potential advance of 46%.

With sales growing 35-40% toward $2 billion next year, the stock trades around 7.5X sales. That's attractive given the growth rates, and the recent initiation by Goldman was well timed as ONTO shares were finding support at $240 during the pre-Fed market pullback. Here were the post-earnings analyst moves...

Needham & Company's Charles Shi bumped his price target to $360 from $330.

Evercore ISI veteran NVIDIA analyst Mark Lipacis kicked his PT to $390 up from $350.

Jefferies & Company's Blayne Peter Curtis grabbed the high Street target at $400 from his prior $350.

And on August 17, Goldman Sachs analyst James E Schneider joined the party with a Strong Buy initiation and $400 valuation target.

Quarter Highlights

Margin Expansion: Non-GAAP gross margins expanded to 57.0% in Q2 2026, up from 54.5% in the prior year, reflecting a favorable product mix heavily weighted toward advanced packaging.

Earnings Power: Non-GAAP operating margins reached 30.0%, generating non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.93 in Q2 2026.

Capital Position: The company ended Q2 2026 with a highly-liquid balance sheet, holding $1.88 billion in cash and short-term investments.

Competitive Landscape

Onto Innovation competes in a consolidated, highly technical market characterized by high barriers to entry.

KLA Corp (KLAC) is a direct competitor as the dominant incumbent in front-end wafer inspection and metrology. Onto successfully captures market share by focusing aggressively on back-end advanced packaging and specialty metrology niches.

Applied Materials (AMAT) is a broad competitor as the leader in deposition and etch, but it also competes in process control. AMAT has vast scale, but Onto remains more purely leveraged to the specific inspection requirements of advanced packaging.

Camtek (CAMT) is Onto's closest pure-play competitor in 2D/3D advanced packaging inspection. Both benefit from the same AI and HBM tailwinds, though Onto boasts higher overall revenue scale and a broader metrology portfolio.

Entegris (ENTG) & FormFactor (FORM) are considered adjacent peers. Entegris focuses on materials and contamination control, while FormFactor specializes in electrical test and probe cards. They operate in the same ecosystem and are often benchmarked together, but they generally do not compete head-to-head in optical inspection.

One of my favorite companies in the "test & measurement" space is Viavi (VIAV) which is coming out of a nice 2-month base in the mid-$30s. I own it for the Zacks TAZR Trader portfolio along with NVDA, TSM, Micron (MU), and Lumentum (LITE).

Bottom line: While I grabbed many bargains during the July "Leopold Leverage Liquidation," I mis-read the head-fake lower in the Semiconductor value chain before the Fed meeting. But it's clear now that the 3-headed Cerberus of Fed-Iran-Midterms is no match for the AI Transformation and so I'm looking for an entry in ONTO very soon. $280 would be a buy.

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資縮手僅加碼26億元 連3買累計554億元 分析師：態度偏多但保守
news.Content:
台股今（2）日開高走揚，終場收在48,475點，再創收盤歷史新高，不過外資買盤卻未同步放大，今日僅小幅買超26.21億元，雖呈連3買、累計加碼554.15億元，但買超力道低於投信的49.09億元。啟發投顧分析師白易弘表示，今日台積電、聯發科等權值股未明顯走強，加上市場等待今晚公布的美國9月非農就業、失業率等重要數據，外資目前態度偏多，但操作仍相對保守。

台股創高外資僅買26億元 白易弘：偏多但仍觀望

白易弘表示，台股今日雖再創收盤歷史新高，但大盤實際僅上漲122點，權值股也沒有明顯漲勢，從法人籌碼來看，今日投信買超49.09億元，買超金額高於外資的26.21億元。他指出，今日法人買盤以投信力道較為明顯。

至於外資為何相對保守，白易弘表示，市場仍在等待美國非農、失業率等重要經濟數據公布，因此外資目前偏向觀望，待數據出爐後，後續態勢才會更加明朗。

白易弘指出，外資目前已連續3個交易日買超，因此整體態度仍偏多，只是操作相對保守，若後續美國經濟數據使市場預期出現變化，外資動向也可能受到影響；若目前市場環境沒有明顯改變，則可能維持小買小賣格局。

外資連3買554億元 投信連4日站買方

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計買超95.57億元。其中，外資也同步買超26.21億元，呈連3買，累計買超554.15億元。

投信今日也同步買超，今日合計買超49.09億元，呈連4買，累計買超196.44億元。

自營商則合計買超20.26億元，呈連3買，其中自行買賣買超47.41億元，避險操作賣超27.15億元。

台股今日守住4萬8千點大關，加權指數終場收在48,475點，上漲122點，再創收盤歷史新高。成交量約9,331億元。權王台積電（2330）終場收在2,500元，下跌10元。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》銀髮經濟—WELL、VTR、CTRE
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-02 15:06:30 數位內容中心 發佈

Welltower（WELL.US）

2026年第2季，Welltower的高齡住宅直接營運模式已占總營運收入淨額（NOI）約70%，同店SHOP營運收入淨額年增20.5%，入住率升至89.4%。這使本週最清楚的訊號是，公司正更直接承接高齡住宅復甦帶來的提價與入住率改善。

Ventas（VTR.US）

2026年9月，Ventas將全年normalized FFO指引上修至每股3.85至3.90美元，並把全年投資指引提高至45億美元。其美國SHOP營運收入淨額年增18%，且入住率超過90%的社區營運收入淨額成長25%，顯示高入住資產的獲利彈性正在放大。

CareTrust REIT（CTRE.US）

2026年以來，CareTrust REIT已部署約15億美元資金，其中第2季約9億美元，穩定化綜合收益率為8.9%。本週值得記住的主題訊號是，公司正加快在熟練護理與高齡住宅的不動產擴張，同步把季度股利提高至每股0.39美元。

National Health Investors（NHI.US）

2026年，National Health Investors的SHOP投資年增137%至約8.5億美元，占公司比重升至24%，管理目標進一步提高至40%至50%。這代表本週最明確的變化，是公司正由triple-net房東模式轉向更高比重的高齡住宅直接營運配置。

Omega Healthcare Investors（OHI.US）

2026年，Omega Healthcare Investors把季度股利由每股0.67美元調高至0.68美元，為2019年後首次調升，全年AFFO指引也上修至每股3.22至3.26美元。這反映公司在熟齡護理出租為主的架構下，現金流與配息能力同步改善。

news.Title: 【盤後焦點】台股漲122點續創收盤新高　本週上漲451點週線連三紅
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2日電）台股今天資金持續流向被動元件、記憶體及ABF載板族群，台積電 (2330) 等權值股今天拉回狹幅整理，終場台積電下跌10元、力守2500元整數關卡，台股上漲122.25點，收在48475.74點，續創收盤新高。

加權指數終場收在48475.74點，漲122.25點，漲幅0.25%，成交金額新台幣8981.74億元；週線收紅451.14點，連三週收紅。

台積電收盤力守2500元整數關卡，跌10元；聯發科 (2454) 收4950元，下跌30元，跌幅0.6%；台達電 (2308) 收1885元，跌20元，跌幅1.05%；鴻海 (2317) 收251點，跌3元，跌幅1.18%。

被動元件族群今天延續漲勢，華新科 (2492) 收在漲停價361.5元，國巨 (2327) 收626元、上揚3.99%；印刷電路板廠臻鼎-KY (4958) 、泰鼎-KY (4927) 攻上漲停板收561元及48.15元，南電 (8046) 、景碩 (3189) 、欣興 (3037) 漲幅介於2.82%至7.41%。

面板雙虎轉型題材持續增溫，友達 (2409) 收40.45元，漲5.61%；群創 (3481) 收52.8元，上揚0.96%。

康和投顧資深經理呂晉維接受電訪表示，台股自17000多點漲到逾48000點，漲3萬多點只花了1年多時間，因此需要時間整理，但台股自7月修正以來，反彈已達跌幅一半，可謂強勢整理；不過若扣除台積電、金融股漲幅後，其實台股集中市場仍處於整理格局，與櫃買市場、美股費城半導體指數走勢相似。

呂晉維指出，美國期中選舉將近，影響美股表現，且美公債殖利率維持高檔，台股仍將受美股等因素牽動，呈現高檔整理格局。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 台股ETF規模逾8兆! 0050就占2.5兆穩居第一
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者林浩宇

ETF規模再創高！台股行情走高，加上投資人申購熱度升溫，兩大推力助攻，台股ETF總規模一舉突破8兆元大關。「2000億元俱樂部」也再添新兵，成員來到9檔，其中0050依舊穩坐規模霸主，資產規模更突破2.5兆元。隨著ETF投資越來越普及，一筆筆資金持續湧入，也替台股注入更多活水。

ETF投資人 王先生：「定期定額累積財富、打敗大盤，但是去年因為AI的關係，去年到今年一整年報酬率突然衝上來，對我來講就是投資ETF的意外之財。」

一筆意外之財，其實是從一場意外開始，王先生7年前原本只是想幫小孩存錢，意外踏入ETF市場，一路定期定額，沒想到碰上AI行情，如今也累積一筆可觀資產。

ETF投資人 王先生：「目前0050、006208，報酬率大概都100多%，像00878也是100%左右，然後00407A差不多20多%，很多真的很多，長輩現在有0050的人非常多像我們公司的年輕人，身邊很多人都有。」

從年輕人到長輩，ETF投資越來越普及，規模也像滾雪球一樣越滾越大，台股ETF總規模再度突破8兆元、改寫新高，其中元大台灣50、元大高股息、富邦台50等六檔千億元的台股ETF，近期也紛紛寫下規模新紀錄。

顧德投顧分析師 黃紫東：「本身是有兩個因素，第一個就是因為股價的創高，ETF的價格當然本身水漲船高，第二件事情，就是申購人數的增加。」

雙重的推力，也讓大型ETF規模持續壯大，其中「2000億元俱樂」再添一名新成員，凱基台灣TOP50擠進，成為第九檔規模突破2000億元的台股ETF。資產規模排行榜，依舊由0050稱霸，規模超過2兆5000億元，這樣的規模，更是第二到第五名的3至5倍。

顧德投顧分析師 黃紫東：「不是獨厚哪一家權值公司，而是在這個地方呈現多點開花，大家輪番動的狀況，整體而言對台股而言，算是一個正面的挹注。」

一筆又一筆的定期定額，匯集成資金活水，不只讓投資人的資產規模越來越多，也讓台股ETF規模持續改寫天花板。（記者林浩宇、林秋強／台北報導）

news.Title: 〈台股盤後〉被動元件、光通訊中小型股奮起 收48475點再創收盤新高
news.Content:
電子權值股今(2)日多無表態，早盤呈現震盪走勢，一度跌逾百點至48205.81點，但被動元件、光通訊、PCB、矽晶圓等中小股盤中接棒撐盤，帶動大盤走揚，最高漲至48491.62點，距盤中歷史新高 48601.53 點僅差臨門一腳，不過，終場漲 122.25 點或 0.25%，收 48475.74 點，仍寫收盤新高，成交量8981.74億元。

台股本周累計上漲 451.14 點，周線寫下連三紅。電子權值股今天休兵，台積電(2330-TW)跌10元或0.4%，收2500元，鴻海(2317-TW)、台達電(2308-TW)雙雙跌逾1%，聯發科(2454-TW)、廣達(2382-TW)皆小跌0.6%，聯電(2303-TW)則收平盤。

被動元件需求強勁，今天全面上攻，華新科(2492-TW)、勤凱(4760-TW)、天二科技(6834-TW)亮燈漲停，鈞寶(6155-TW)漲逾4%，國巨*(2327-TW)漲逾3%，金山電(8042-TW)、密望實(8043-TW)、凱美(2375-TW)皆有1至2%的漲幅。

光通訊族群今天同樣閃亮，且多檔亮燈，台聯電(4905-TW)、穩懋(3105-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)、前鼎(4908-TW)、聯亞(3081-TW)、環宇-KY(4991-TW)、光聖(6442-TW)紛紛強攻漲停，波若崴(3163-TW)、全新(2455-TW)、華星光(4979-TW)漲逾半根停板，上銓(3363-TW)漲逾4%。

另外，國際油價反彈上漲逾4%，塑化族群今天同步點火，台塑四寶強勢表態，台塑化(6505-TW)漲逾6%，站上百元關卡，台化(1326-TW)漲逾半根停板，台塑(1301-TW)、南亞(1303-TW)漲逾2%。而台苯(1310-TW)也漲逾半根停板，台達化(1309-TW)、華夏(1305-TW)皆有3至4%漲幅。

news.Title: 中小型轉強、光通訊強勢反攻，台股下週量能成關鍵
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股店頭市場週五開紅走高漲逾1.9%，成交量加溫至2,717億元，中小型股率先轉強；集中市場早盤一度壓回，終場則拉升收紅，成交量也略有回升。若下週成交量能能進一步放大，將有利大盤延續向上格局。　　其中，聯發科(2454)股價出現十字線，成交量也明顯收縮，顯示短線仍處於整理階段。下一階段若股價能重新站回5,000元以上，將有利於多頭信心回升，也可望帶動大盤再度挑戰新高。

至於大立光(3008)開低走高，以6,290元收市，玉晶光(3406)也由黑翻紅，顯示短線下檔支撐力道有所增強。與此同時，光通訊族群展開反攻，聯亞(3081)及光聖(6442)更攻上漲停，若相關個股後續持續轉強，第四季光通訊族群將有進一步表現空間，也可能成為大盤向上攻堅的重要主力。

另外，漢翔(2634)也出現轉強跡象，若股價後續能再度突破66.6元，則以無人機為題材的相關個股，也有機會受到市場資金關注。整體而言，後續盤面能否延續強勢，量能變化與指標股表現仍是重要觀察重點。

news.Title: 《DJ在線》AI改寫記憶體長約，鎖產能走向共同開發
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-02 12:20:12 周佩宇 發佈

AI推升記憶體需求，也正改變原廠與客戶的合作模式。業者指出，過去記憶體長約（LTA）多以一年、兩年的產能及價格安排為主，近一年則明顯轉向策略型合作，除了供貨及價格保障，部分合作更延伸至下一代產品共同開發；美光（Micron）最新也揭露，策略客戶協議（SCA）已由6月的16份增至26份，部分期限更延伸至2031年。台灣主要記憶體原廠包括南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）、旺宏（2337）等，其中DRAM供應吃緊下，南亞科今年長約（LTA）占產能比重已達約50%，部分客戶更簽下3年供貨協議，顯示記憶體長約正從單純「鎖產能」走向供應、價格及技術路線更深度的綁定。

業者表示，傳統LTA通常約定一年或兩年的產能，價格則依合約逐步調整；現在則出現更多策略型LTA，除了可能設有最低價格保障，部分合作時間更長，客戶下一代產品開發也會提前與記憶體廠的產品路線對接。相較兩年前此類合作仍不普遍，近一年客戶對長期供應及共同開發的需求明顯增加。

美光最新揭露的SCA也反映相同趨勢。截至9月底，美光已簽署26份多年期SCA，採取take-or-pay承購機制，公司估計相關協議涵蓋至2030年超過35%的營收；其中約四分之三預估營收已有明確定價框架，多數設有價格上下限，其餘則定期依市場價格重新議價。部分SCA已延伸至2031年，26份協議及延長案取得的客戶財務承諾合計達320億美元，絕大多數為現金存款。

值得注意的是，長約功能已不只是避免缺貨。美光表示，SCA除提高長期供應規畫的能見度，也能深化與客戶在技術roadmap上的合作；先前與福特（Ford）、通用汽車（GM）及車用Tier 1供應鏈簽署的SCA，也涵蓋未來記憶體需求規畫、技術合作及新平台所需產能。其中，美光與GM的合作更延伸至下一代車用平台的記憶體及儲存需求，顯示原廠與客戶關係逐步由採購端向產品開發前期延伸。

美光預期，2027、2028年DRAM與NAND供需都將比2026年更為吃緊，其中DRAM結構性供需缺口仍在，公司目前甚至無法明確判斷供需何時恢復平衡；也因SCA提高直到2030年以後的需求能見度，美光已決定進一步提高2027財年資本支出規畫，加速2028年底以後的無塵室產能建置。

台灣也者也指出，目前記憶體市場又以DRAM相對稀缺，AI運算持續增加容量需求，也使客戶更積極確保中長期供應；對同時具備DRAM與NAND產品線的原廠而言，客戶亦可能將不同記憶體產品納入整體供貨安排。隨供需吃緊時間拉長，記憶體產業過去高度仰賴現貨及季度議價的交易模式，也開始增加更長期的供應承諾及策略合作。

news.Title: 台積電擴廠選項再＋1 外媒爆亞洲這國也入列
news.Content:
台積電海外擴廠布局持續受到市場關注，除了傳出正評估在美國德州興建新的大型園區，美國財經報導，台積電曾與新加坡政府洽談半導體投資，顯示新加坡同樣是海外擴產選項之一。

台積電是輝達與蘋果的主要晶片製造商，隨著AI硬體需求持續增加，公司正評估進一步擴大海外產能。報導指出，台積電已承諾在美國亞利桑那州大型園區投入2650億美元，興建多座晶圓廠，若德州投資案落實，將進一步擴大其在美國的製造布局。

對於赴德州及新加坡擴廠的相關傳聞，台積電透過簡訊回應表示：「對於市場傳聞，不予評論。」新加坡經濟發展局則拒絕置評。知情人士指出，目前相關計畫仍處於初步階段，尚未正式拍板。

新加坡近年積極爭取半導體投資，吸引多家全球科技企業進駐，目前當地已有格羅方德、聯電、世界先進等業者設置晶圓廠，包括近期世界先進新加坡廠首座12吋廠於上月28日舉行開幕典禮。隨著AI產業快速發展，新加坡希望進一步強化其在AI與半導體供應鏈中的角色。

此外，台積電也傳出考慮在美國德州興建新園區，美國總統川普接受專訪時稱「一家偉大的台灣晶片公司」正在美國投資5000億美元，外界推測正是台積電。外媒指出，若計畫最終定案，可能包括設立多座晶圓廠，每座廠投資金額至少達200億美元。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】翻紅漲逾百點　站上48400點
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年10月2日電）美股齊揚，費城半導體指數大漲1.59%，台股開高隨後走勢震盪，一度跌至48205.81點，在台積電 (2330) 盤中跌勢收斂影響下，台股也由黑翻紅，盤中漲逾百點，最高達48490.26點，站上48400點。

加權指數11時20分漲82.83點，達48436.32點，成交金額約新台幣6058億元。

台積電 (2330) 盤中跌15元至2495元，但隨後跌勢收斂；聯發科 (2454) 跌100元至4880元後跌勢收斂；台達電 (2308) 低點1880元，下挫25元；鴻海 (2317) 最低250.5元，跌3.5元。

在傳出美國將增派部隊與航空母艦前往中東，以及中國暫停油品出口後，市場憂心全球燃料短缺問題可能加劇，國際油價今天大漲。台塑化 (6505) 盤中高點103元，勁揚9.34%；台塑 (1301) 達69.6元，漲4.19%；南亞 (1303) 為259.5元，上揚2.16%；台化 (1326) 勁揚7.23%至72.6元。

上櫃電子通路商巨虹 (8084) 因現增案破局，上週宣布轉辦理私募，但日前公告，私募案未能在繳款期間內收足，導致原本擬間接收購百略醫學的3000萬美元（約新台幣9.54億元）訂金將被賣方沒收，須於第3季財報認列相關損失，期末淨值恐轉為負數，甚至有下櫃疑慮。今天被列為全額交割股，盤中鎖住跌停21.80元。

news.Title: 台股市值首度突破170兆大關！00981A今年績效飆逾8成、規模增近5倍
news.Content:
受惠AI供應鏈強勁爆發，台股再創歷史新高！上市公司總市值從去年底的94.36兆元，昨日一舉突破170兆元大關。今年大盤累計漲幅約64%，同步帶動市場新寵「主動式ETF」買氣爆棚，整體規模從年初1,695億元暴增至今已突破兆元，成為本波牛市行情中最吸金的焦點。其中，擁有94萬投資人的 00981A 今年以來績效達 83%，榮登台股主動式ETF霸主。

主動式ETF規模激增，關鍵在於操盤績效碾壓大盤。根據CMoney統計，今年以來台股主動式ETF績效，主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)今年以來大漲83.32%居冠，規模達2,907億元，大增485%；主動群益科技創新(00992A-TW)以82.36%緊追在後。此外，主動野村台灣50(00985A-TW)、主動復華未來50 (00991A-TW)及主動台新優勢成長(00987A-TW)，今年績效亦達71%~77%以上。

統一投信台股研究團隊指出，近期全球金融市場受利率與地緣政治影響震盪，雖美債殖利率仍處高檔，但市場對升息預期已降溫，後續將關注PCE及非農就業數據。若就業市場緩步降溫，有助降低升息壓力、支撐股市評價，預期台股短線維持高檔震盪，待10/15台積電法說會後，屆時受惠先進製程樂觀展望帶動，大盤有機會突破整理結構走高。

展望後市，統一投信台股研究團隊進一步指出，目前仍是以受惠CSP資本支出的AI供應鏈與先進製程。看好具經常性需求的半導體耗材、Google TPU概念股、明年放量的NPO近封裝光學族群、記憶體及規格升級相關概念股。

news.Title: 國泰證美股盤前盤後交易服務上線　最早下午4時可下單
news.Content:
（中央社記者曾仁凱台北2026年10月2日電）美國那斯達克（NASDAQ）12月6日起將延長交易時間。國泰證券今天表示，「國泰證券App」已於9月30日起正式推出美股盤前、盤後交易服務，提供更完整的美股交易時段。先前兆豐證券已表示將推出美股盤前交易複委託，富邦證券本週也宣布10月1日起推出美股盤前及盤後交易服務。

國泰證券表示，隨著全球市場的連動性日益提升，尤其近年台、美AI供應鏈休戚相關，投資人對即時掌握國際市場行情的需求持續增加。國泰證券自9月30日起於「國泰證券App」正式推出美股盤前盤後交易服務。

以夏令時間為例，投資人最早可於台灣時間下午4時開始交易，最晚可參與市場至隔日凌晨5時30分，交易時段涵蓋盤前、盤中及盤後。從台股收盤到美股收市，無縫掌握海內外投資契機。

根據券商公會統計，國泰證券7月複委託成交金額新台幣3076億元，市占率22.2%，居市場第一；其中零售客戶市場占有率達26.6%。

國泰證券表示，美股長期為台灣投資人布局海外的重要市場，但影響股價的重要訊息往往不只發生在一般交易時段，包括美國上市公司財報、聯準會政策訊息，以及非農就業、消費者物價指數（CPI）等關鍵經濟數據，都可能於盤前或盤後發布。此次國泰證推出美股盤前盤後交易服務，希望幫助台灣投資人能與美國市場同步，即時參與，不錯過市場關鍵時刻。

news.Title: 台股站穩4萬8千點，能否再創高聚焦台積電、聯發科與光通訊
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股大盤站穩4萬8千點以上，後續能否再創新高，市場可從幾項重要指標觀察。首先是台積電(2330)法說會，在市場期待偏向正面的情況下，接下來台積電股價能否進一步反映利多、重新向上挺升，將是影響大盤續攻的重要觀察點。　　其次，聯發科(2454)在創下新高後出現拉回，若後續股價能重新站回5,000元以上，將有利於市場多頭信心延續，也可望成為台股進一步向上突破的重要指標。

此外，光通訊題材可能成為第4季盤面的重要焦點，大立光(3008)預計10月8日召開法說會，相關展望值得留意。除了大立光之外，玉晶光(3406)、全新(2455)、聯亞(3081)、波若威(3163)、高明鐵(4573)，以及甫登錄興櫃的東佑達(7942)等，後續股價表現也可能成為光通訊族群的重要觀察指標。若相關指標股能延續強勢，將有助於市場資金持續聚焦光通訊題材。

news.Title: SanDisk (SNDK) vs. Seagate (STX): Which Storage Stock Is the Better Buy Right Now?
news.Content: The AI trade is moving beyond GPUs. As AI models become more capable, they also generate, process, and retain massive amounts of data. That is creating a less glamorous but increasingly important question for data centers: where does all that data go? SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK ) and Seagate Technology Holdings plc (NASDAQ: STX ) offer two very different answers. SanDisk is benefiting from growing demand for NAND flash and enterprise SSDs, while Seagate is betting that the sheer volume of AI-generated data will keep driving demand ...
news.AI_Summary:
• SanDisk (SNDK) is benefiting from increased demand for NAND flash and enterprise SSDs driven by AI's data storage needs.
• Data center business now represents 38% of SanDisk's portfolio, up from 12% a year prior, with long-term agreements locking in over half of its fiscal 2027 output.
• Seagate (STX) focuses on high-capacity hard drives for AI-generated data, with its data center business comprising 90% of exabyte shipments.
• SanDisk trades at a significantly lower forward P/E ratio (8.04x) compared to Seagate (25.71x), making it appear more compelling despite Seagate's predictable revenue and cash flow.
news.Keywords: NAND flash, enterprise SSD, data storage, AI tailwinds, valuation comparison

news.Title: Tesla Is the Only Magnificent Seven Stock in the Red for 2026
news.Content:
It's been a good year for most of the Magnificent Seven. As of this writing, Apple and Nvidia are both up over 23% in 2026, and even Microsoft , the smallest gainer, is up about 7%. Alphabet , Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META), and Amazon land in between.

Then there's Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA). At roughly $347 as of this writing, the electric-car maker's shares are down about 23% this year and about 29% off their record close of $489.88, set in December 2025.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

It's the only one of the seven in the red.

The strange part, I think, is that Tesla's sales are rising again. The gap shows up further down the income statement.

Image source: Getty Images.

Is demand the problem?

Not lately. Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in the second quarter, up 25% year over year and a sharp acceleration from 6% growth in the first quarter. This followed a tough 2025, when deliveries dropped around 9% to 1,636,129.

Tesla's second-quarter revenue climbed 26% year over year to about $28.2 billion, beating the latest-quarter growth rates for Apple (16%), Microsoft (18%), Amazon (20%), and Alphabet (24%).

Yes, some of that's a rebound from a poor 2025. But on sales alone, Tesla fits right in with the rest of the group.

Tesla's profits aren't keeping up

Showing how little of that growth reaches the bottom line, Tesla's second-quarter operating income dropped 57% year over year to around $398 million. Its operating margin (the share of revenue left as operating profit) shrank to just 1.4%, down from 4.1% in the year-ago quarter, as operating expenses jumped 47%. Non-GAAP (adjusted) earnings per share dropped 18%. And in the first half of 2026, Tesla delivered 16% more vehicles than a year before but earned around the same operating income ($1.34 billion vs. $1.32 billion).

The other six look very different. Five of them raised operating income by double digits in their latest quarters, from 18% at Microsoft to 124% at Nvidia.

Even Amazon, which has the lowest margins among the six, kept about 14 cents of every sales dollar as operating profit. Tesla kept about 1.4 cents.

Meta's the exception. Its second-quarter operating income dropped 8%, hurt by $2.4 billion in legal charges and $1.18 billion in severance. But its operating margin was still 31%, and management expects full-year operating income to beat 2025's.

Story Continues

Spending first

Sure, low margins might matter less if the payoff looked close. But Tesla expects capital expenditures of over $25 billion in 2026, due to its AI initiatives. With around $8.3 billion spent in the first half, that implies more than $16 billion in the second. Second-quarter free cash flow was already negative $1.1 billion. And on Sept. 29, Tesla signed $30 billion in new credit facilities, but it doesn't currently plan to tap them this year.

The projects this spending funds are still early. Tesla's Robotaxi service was live in seven major metro areas by its second-quarter update, and the steering-wheel-free Cybercab began giving rides to Robotaxi app users in a limited part of Austin in early September. But Tesla doesn't break out robotaxi revenue, so investors can't yet tell what the service makes.

Meanwhile, the stock already prices in a lot of success. Based on next year's expected earnings, Tesla's price-to-earnings ratio is around 155. Nvidia's stock, in comparison, costs about 15 times next fiscal year's expected earnings, even though its operating income more than doubled last quarter.

What can the delivery count add?

Tesla hasn't given a date for its third-quarter delivery release. But its past two quarterly counts came out on the second day of a new quarter, so the next one may arrive within days.

A year ago, Tesla delivered a record 497,099 vehicles, so it probably needs another record just to show growth. Still, even a strong count can't settle what separates Tesla from the other six this year.

"Tesla vehicle deliveries and storage deployments represent only two measures of the Company's financial performance and should not be relied on as an indicator of quarterly financial results," the company wrote in its July 2 delivery report.

In the end, Tesla's 2026 problem isn't that customers quit buying its cars. It's that the business keeps very little of what it sells -- while spending heavily on projects that haven't paid off yet. At around 320 times the past year's earnings, I'd say Tesla stock's still too pricey for a company that kept 1.4 cents in operating profit on every sales dollar last quarter.

news.Title: 台股開盤小漲37點後陷震盪！台積電小跌5元、開2505元
news.Content:
即時中心／綜合報導

美債殖利率從高點回落，帶動美股扭轉跌勢；美光財報與展望優於預期，加上Anthropic上市消息，支撐科技股與半導體股走高，華爾街指數週四（1日）全面收紅。另台指期夜盤下跌223點、0.46％，收在48,475點。台股今（2）日開盤以48,390.65點開出、小漲37.16點，隨後持續震盪。台積電（2330）今以2,505元開出、小跌5元。

電子權值股方面，鴻海（2317）開253元，跌1元；聯發科（2454）以4,950元開出，跌30元；廣達（2382）跌1元，開在333元；台達電（2308）小跌5元，以1,895元開出；日月光投控（3711）開711元，漲1元；聯電（2303）開159元，跌2.5元；大立光（3008）開6,205元平盤價。

金融方面，富邦金（2881）跌1.5元，開在149元；國泰金（2882）下滑0.5元，開110元；中信金（2891）以67.3元開出，下滑0.6元；兆豐金（2886）開48.85元平盤價；華南金（2880）開在44.95元，跌0.3元；第一金（2892）下滑0.3元，以38.4元開出；合庫金（5880）開25.8元，下滑0.2元。

news.Title: 台股繼續衝！開盤上漲近百點 記憶體回神南亞科漲逾2％
news.Content:
美國公債殖利率從20多年來高點回落，費半上漲逾1.5%，不過日、韓股市下跌，台股昨創收盤新高後今面臨賣壓，開盤小漲80點，約來到48419.98點。

記憶體股回神，南亞科漲逾2%，華邦電及威剛漲逾1%。權值股休息，台積電跌10元至2500元，聯發科及台達電跌逾1%。

林漢偉分析師表示，今日台股維持高檔量縮橫盤，短線漲幅已大，加上國際局勢仍不穩定，電子權值股普遍轉為觀望。美股雖然全面收紅，但台指期夜盤下跌223點，中小型股輪動速度仍快，操作上不宜過度追高。

林漢偉指出，台股周五維持高檔橫盤震盪，近期成交量持續低迷，量能能否回升將決定下一波方向。外資現貨連續買超，但期貨空單小幅增加，整體籌碼面仍維持中性。

台股1日收在48,353.49點，站上4萬8千點，終場上漲413.36點，漲幅0.86%，成交量8,374.31億元，外資買超219.37億元

美股道瓊上漲20.51點或0.04%，收50,926.56點。S&P500上漲14.91點或0.19%，收7,666.45點。NASDAQ上漲10.53點或0.04%，收26,871.60點。費城半導體上漲200.38點或1.59%，收12,829.00點。

news.Title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Challenges EU Orders to Open Up to AI and Search Rivals
news.Content: Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) has challenged two European Union orders that would require Google to give AI companies access to its services and search competitors access to its search data, according to a Reuters report on September 29. Google argues the measures would undermine user privacy and security. The orders fall under the Digital Markets Act, and the changes they require are due to take effect in 2027. READ ALSO: Alphabet (GOOGL)'s Google Bets on Finland's Cold Weather and Nuclear Power for its Next ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Alphabet (Google) is challenging two EU orders under the Digital Markets Act that would require it to grant AI companies access to its services and search competitors access to its search data.
• Google argues these measures would undermine user privacy and security, and that the raw search data is its competitive moat.
• The EU contends that query history is crucial for good search results, and providing it would significantly benefit competitors, especially AI companies building direct-answer products.
• Alphabet's strong financial position ($445.87 billion LTM revenue, 34.03% operating margin, $242.47 billion cash) allows for a prolonged legal fight, and investors do not appear to be pricing in significant earnings risk.
news.Keywords: antitrust, Digital Markets Act, regulatory challenge, search data, competitive moat

news.Title: 科學園區增13件投資案；南亞科進駐屏科
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-02 08:50:47 新聞中心 發佈

國科會昨(1)日召開科學園區審議會會議，會中通過13件投資案，投資總額約512.19億元，此外尚有20件增資案，合計增資約849.20億元。國科會此次核准投資案包含南亞科(2408)進駐屏東科學園區，設立分公司，屏東縣政府對此表示樂見其成，並期待高科技大廠為屏東產業升級帶來新的契機與更多就業機會，促進經濟發展。

國科會指出，南亞科落腳屏東科學園區，主要從事先進半導體3D晶圓封裝及測試業務，公司以矽穿孔與晶圓堆疊技術，開發高容量、高頻寬、低延遲、低功耗之記憶體模組，並透過深化客戶合作與確保供應鏈彈性，持續推動技術創新，穩固產品獨特性與市場領先地位。未來進駐園區後，公司將持續深化在地生產與技術研發，提升國內高效能記憶體產品自主研發與製造專業能力，並帶動南部半導體產業聚落及人才培育。

屏東縣政府指出，屏東科學園區從2020年行政院核定籌設計畫後，同年7月開始啟動招商，2023年5月展開公共工程施作，預計2027年完成，有多家廠商同步動土建廠中，如今再加上南亞科技核准入園，充分證明國家政策「大南方新矽谷」S廊帶已正式延伸至屏東，屏東正式跨入半導體國家隊，站上全球供應鏈的關鍵版圖。

屏東縣政府強調，早已備妥穩定的水電、綠能與土地資源，交通上也推進高鐵南延、高屏二快屏東端動土與台鐵六塊厝站西遷；生活與教育方面，結合屏科實中招生、大專院校產學合作、四大醫學中心醫療網，並搭配育兒津貼、優惠房貸與社會住宅；休閒上則打造國際棒球場與藝文場域，希望能打造出科技新城。

屏東縣政府表示，南亞科技與科技大廠的進駐，將為屏東帶來在地高薪就業機會，更能吸引青年與專業人才回流；同時，高科技量能也將帶動在地相關產業鏈發展，甚至加速傳統農漁業的智慧升級，為屏東整體經濟注入強勁動能。

news.Title: 美股四大指數週四翻紅，台股維持震盪盤勢機率高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／魏聖峰】美債殖利率下跌，加上美光科技股價反彈3%激勵，費城半導體指數10/1上漲1.59%，並帶動其他美股三大指數翻紅，這樣的情況下，對週五的台股表現維持中性看法。不過，週四台股已先反彈，台指期電子盤在週四美股交易期間下跌下跌0.46%，顯示台股短線有獲利了結壓力，若早盤開盤後台股開高下殺，可先觀察再動作。若週五早盤日股電子零組件相關股持續上漲，有利週五台股表現。週四美股交易中，Nvidia股價上漲1.09%、應用材料股價上漲3.5%、美光科技股價上漲3.03%、威騰電子股價上漲1.78%、Sandisk股價上漲2.75%、海力士ADR上漲5.08%。台積電ADR上漲0.66%、日月光ADR上漲0.61%、聯電ADR上漲2.94%。受惠日本股市週四的上漲激勵，台股開盤開高後，加權指數盤中一度震盪到平盤附近，隨著日股零組件股的上漲激勵，加權指數加足馬力往上攻堅，並以相對高點作收。就技術面型態來說，短線5日線是短線最強支撐點，近期由於台股創新高後拉回幅度不大，維持高檔震盪並進行換手整理。基本上有利於多頭持續攻堅。現在台股最大的風險就是國際股市，尤其是美國半導體股若有較明顯的回檔，這對高檔震盪的台股來說是最大的風險。

週四台股會有不錯的漲勢，要歸功於日股零組件相關股的表現。受到日本政府公布的短觀預測創下八年半新高，凸顯日本製造業看好未來景氣，帶動日股表現。週四日股強勢股中，以被動元件、矽晶圓、半導體設備股和PCB相關股為主，這牽動台股相關股表現。

日股被動元件龍頭的村田製作所、太陽誘電股價分別大漲8.43%、8.32%，而TDK股價也上漲7.35%，帶動早盤被動元件股全面受到資金拉抬而大漲，讓被動元件股出現許久未現的強勢表現。國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)股價都攻到漲停板鎖死，禾伸堂(3026)股價漲幅也將近8%。千如(3236)、臺慶科(3357)、勤凱(4760)、華容(5382)、九豪(6127)、鈞寶(6155)、信昌電(6173)等股都漲停板鎖死。其他未漲停鎖死的股票也都相當強勢，凱美(2375)、立隆電(2472)、大毅(2478)、日電貿(3090)、興勤(2428)、金山電(8042)、蜜望實(8043)等股股價漲幅也都不錯。被動元件股在低檔盤整有一段時間，9月起國巨*開始漲價，基本面持續好轉中，可留意後市表現。

日股矽晶圓大廠的勝高(Sumco)週四股價上漲4.7%，也一度帶動台股矽晶圓股表現。但可惜的是，環球晶(6488)早盤股價開高一度攻上漲停板，之後漲幅收斂，收盤漲幅僅約4.83%。中美晶(5483)、台勝科(3532)和合晶(6182)早盤股價都一度開高強勢，卻也都遭到空方突襲，台勝科和合晶收盤時以下跌作收。日股功率半導體大廠的羅姆週四股價上漲歐3.34%，也帶動功率元件股的強茂(2481)、台半(5425)和德微(3675)的股價表現，尤其以德微股價漲幅接近9%表現最強。

雖然強勢股表現不錯，但先前股價曾經大漲過的類股，週四股價漲多拉回，或者是維持盤整。南亞(1303)、台塑(1301)、台化(1326)、IP股的聯發科(2454)、創意(3443)、世芯-KY(3661)、力旺(3529)、M31(6643)等股股價回檔整理，但晶心科(6533)股價攻到漲停鎖死，是表現最強的IP股。

news.Title: Prediction: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Stock Will Skyrocket After Oct. 15
news.Content:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM) has a major event coming up in a few weeks: third-quarter earnings. This could have huge implications not only for Taiwan Semiconductor's stock, but also for everyone else involved in the AI arms race, because it's such a key supplier in the industry.

I think it will have positive news to report, but there are a few things that I'm looking for to confirm the bull case. If everything goes well, I could see the stock taking off, as it's projected to grow at the fastest rate it has ever grown during the AI arms race.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Taiwan Semiconductor is one of the best AI investments out there

Although it's not talked about as much as some of the other major AI companies out there, Taiwan Semiconductor is a leading AI investment pick. The reason is pretty clear: It provides a huge chunk of chips for the industry. During Q2, Taiwan Semiconductor accounted for an estimated 72.5% of the world's chip foundry revenue . That shows just how much of a lead it has over its peers, and that size advantage is a nearly unbreakable moat.

The reality is, even if TSMC's clients were disgruntled and wanted to leave, they couldn't. Nobody else has the production capacity available to match it. However, none of TSMC's clients are upset, as its technology and execution make it an excellent company to work with.

So, as long as there is more spending on AI chips, TSMC should continue to be a viable investment. Fortunately for investors, that's where the market is heading. One of TSMC's largest clients, Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), expects the big five AI hyperscalers to spend nearly $800 billion in data center capital expenditures this year. Next year, that figure rises to $1.3 trillion. Ultimately, they see global data center capital expenditure costs rising to $3 trillion to $4 trillion annually by 2030. That means the market for chips is rising, and with nearly three-fourths of the world's chips (at least by revenue) coming from TSMC, there's a huge growth runway ahead for it.

And that's starting to show up in TSMC's results.

The market expects a strong quarter from TSMC

Wall Street analysts expect an average of 47% revenue growth this quarter and 53% in the next. Those are monster growth figures, and each is far higher than anything Taiwan Semiconductor has produced over the past few quarters.

Story Continues

TSM Revenue (Quarterly YoY Growth) data by YCharts

These elevated growth rates indicate that TSMC is seeing an increase in volume, but it also could be because it's raising its prices. Taiwan Semiconductor is in an excellent position to raise prices, and language from some of the major computing chip suppliers suggests that some of their chip costs are already rising, so they are raising their prices as a result.

I'll be looking to see if TSMC says it's raising prices, as that will point toward strong results lasting into 2027, which could pose significant upside for the stock.

Right now, Taiwan Semiconductor actually trades at a pretty reasonable valuation of 27 times forward earnings.

TSM PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

That's on the higher end of where it has traded over the past two years. Still, if its growth is faster than anything it has previously experienced, then a higher valuation is probably warranted. Regardless, TSMC looks like it's set up to have another strong year in 2027, so I think the stock will likewise continue its success over the next few years.

Taiwan Semiconductor is in a great spot as a business, and if it says the right things, I won't be surprised to see the stock move far higher following its earnings release on Oct. 15.

news.Title: What Is the Worst-Performing "Magnificent Seven" Stock in 2026?
news.Content:
The investment community loves to group certain stocks into various buckets. In recent years, the "Magnificent Seven" have been viewed as an elite collection of businesses because they dominate their end markets and command massive valuations.

But they don't always win. Which of these tech stocks has been the worst performer of 2026?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) has been losing the race. As of Sept. 29, its shares have tumbled 22% this year. However, they have still soared 2,460% over the past decade, offering a wildly successful return for long-term investors.

The company's revenue surged 21% year over year through the first six months of 2026 (ended June 30), with automotive sales rising 24%. Strong growth like this should be viewed favorably.

But profitability has taken a hit. Its operating margin contracted from 4.1% in Q2 2025 to 1.4% last quarter. Research and development expenses were up 49% year over year, while selling, general, and administrative costs jumped 45%.

This electric vehicle stock's valuation isn't rooted in reality, as it trades at a price-to-earnings ratio of 327. Investors clearly still value the business highly. However, an inflated multiple adds meaningful downside risk.

And Tesla continues to test the patience of its shareholders regarding Robotaxi expansion and Optimus production. The company's future depends on these ambitious projects rapidly scaling and generating significant financial returns. Eventually, the stock price's movements should reflect fundamentals more and the narrative less.

news.Title: Intel vs. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
The semiconductor landscape is shifting as national security and manufacturing prowess collide. Investors must choose between a recovering American giant, Intel (NASDAQ:INTC), and the world's premier foundry, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) (NYSE:TSM).

Intel designs and manufactures its own chips while expanding its foundry business to build for others. TSMC focuses solely on manufacturing, serving the world's most advanced technology firms. Both companies are central to the global supply chain, yet they offer vastly different paths for investors looking for growth or turnaround potential.

The case for Intel

Intel designs and manufactures processors and software for cloud, enterprise, and edge customers. In early 2026, the company granted the U.S. government a 10% equity stake, which has since triggered shareholder litigation. Customer concentration like this adds a layer of risk to the business.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $52.9 billion, a decrease of approximately 0.5% from the previous year. The company reported a net loss of roughly $267.0 million, resulting in a net margin of negative 0.5%. This reflects the heavy capital investments required to transition toward its foundry-first strategy.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was nearly 0.4x, which compares total debt to shareholder equity. The current ratio, measuring the ability to cover short-term liabilities with short-term assets, was close to 2.0x. Free cash flow was negative at roughly $4.9 billion, and stock-based compensation accounted for nearly 25.1% of operating cash flow, inflating reported cash generation because SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing operates as a pure-play foundry, manufacturing chips designed by other companies for smartphones and artificial intelligence. While major customers are not explicitly disclosed in its latest filings, it serves nearly every major chip designer among semiconductor stocks . This business model allows it to benefit from industrywide growth without the risk of competing with its own clients.

In FY 2025, revenue reached close to $122.4 billion, a significant increase of approximately 32% over the previous year. The company delivered a net income of nearly $55.1 billion, resulting in a net margin of about 46.3%. These figures demonstrate the immense demand for its advanced manufacturing nodes.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was roughly 0.2x. The current ratio stood at close to 2.5x, indicating a strong position to cover near-term obligations. Free cash flow was robust at approximately $32.2 billion, representing the cash remaining after a company pays for its operations and capital investments.

Story Continues

Risk profile comparison

Intel faces significant litigation risk following its decision to grant a 10% equity stake to the U.S. government. Shareholders have filed lawsuits alleging the deal was intended to mitigate political pressure rather than serve investor interests. Additionally, Intel continues to be described as a beleaguered chipmaker, reflecting its ongoing struggle to regain technical leadership and improve market sentiment.

TSMC faces risks related to its concentration of manufacturing facilities, which are largely based in a single geographic region. While the company has not disclosed specific recent risks in its 10-K, global supply chain disruptions and regional geopolitical tensions remain primary concerns for the foundry. It also faces competitive pressure from Samsung and other rivals as they race to develop more efficient chip-making processes.

Valuation comparison

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing carries a lower Forward P/E based on future earnings estimates, while Intel has a lower P/S ratio using sales over the past twelve months.

Valuation metrics include those sourced from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) and may differ from those of other data providers.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

When it comes to choosing between the two tech stocks, TSMC appears to be the safer and more profitable option.

Indeed, Intel has made a dramatic comeback amid the technical improvements enabled by its 18A technology and the prospect of becoming the leading fab in the U.S.

Nonetheless, despite improvements, Intel's financial struggles continue as it continues to run net losses. While revenue growth returned in the first half of 2026, the $52.9 billion generated in 2025 indicates its lackluster performance in the recent past.

In contrast, TSMC dominates production of the world's most advanced semiconductors, and the $122 billion in revenue it generated in 2025 affirms its dominance. Additionally, it is also a cash generation machine, amid its $32.2 billion in free cash flow for 2025.

Given that, it makes little sense to pay the valuation premium that has arisen from the massive gains in Intel stock. Since demand for advanced chips remains robust, TSMC will likely continue to stand out over the potentially promising but still struggling Intel.

news.Title: Applied Materials vs. ASML: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
As the artificial intelligence boom shifts from hype to hardware, choosing between Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) and ASML (NASDAQ:ASML) requires understanding the specialized tools that make modern computing possible.

These giants operate at different stages of the manufacturing process. While one provides a broad suite of materials engineering tools, the other holds a near-monopoly on the machines that print patterns on advanced chips.

The case for Applied Materials

Applied Materials sells a wide variety of equipment used to deposit, remove, and modify materials on silicon wafers. Its customers include global leaders in the foundry, logic, and memory markets who depend on these tools to build complex chip architectures. In fiscal 2025, two customers accounted for approximately 19% and 15% of net revenue, respectively, while a partnership with TSMC supports critical technology requirements for artificial intelligence.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $28.4 billion, which represents growth of approximately 4.4% compared to the prior year. The company reported net income of close to $7.0 billion for the same period, demonstrating its ability to remain consistently profitable in a shifting market. This resulted in a net margin of 24.7%, which is a measure of how much profit is kept from every dollar of sales after all expenses are paid.

As of its October 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was roughly 0.3x, which compares total debt to shareholder equity to show conservative borrowing levels. The current ratio, measuring the ability to pay short-term debts with short-term assets, was approximately 2.6x. Free cash flow, or the cash remaining after paying for capital expenditures, totaled nearly $5.7 billion and supports the company's ongoing research and development efforts along with its shareholder returns.

The case for ASML

ASML is the sole global provider of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography systems used to print incredibly small patterns on the most advanced chips. By supplying these mission-critical machines to the broader semiconductor stocks landscape, the company has become an essential partner for every major manufacturer. Its proprietary technology is fundamental to the production of high-performance processors used in artificial intelligence and sophisticated mobile devices that require massive computing power.

In FY 2025, revenue reached close to $37.1 billion, representing growth of roughly 15.6% over the prior year. The company reported net income of approximately $10.9 billion during this fiscal year, showing substantial growth in its bottom line. It achieved a net margin of 29.4%, which shows that the business converts a high percentage of sales into actual profit for its shareholders after accounting for all operating costs.

Story Continues

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was approximately 0.1x, which indicates a very light debt load compared to its equity base. The company maintained a current ratio of roughly 1.3x, which compares short-term assets to short-term liabilities to assess the company's immediate liquidity. Free cash flow for the fiscal year reached nearly $12.1 billion, providing the company with ample capital to develop the next generation of high-aperture lithography machines.

Risk profile comparison

Applied Materials faces ongoing costs and scrutiny regarding export control compliance, including a $252 million settlement in February 2026. The business is highly sensitive to geopolitical trade tensions between the U.S. and China, which can disrupt supply chains. Furthermore, its reliance on a few large customers like Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) and competition from firms like KLA (NASDAQ:KLAC) makes it vulnerable to shifts in spending cycles.

ASML operates under strict export restrictions that limit its ability to sell advanced systems to certain markets, particularly China. Because its machines are incredibly complex, any disruption in its global supply chain can significantly delay deliveries and impact revenue. Additionally, the high cost of its next-generation machines may lead to slower adoption by customers like Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD).

Valuation comparison

Applied Materials looks cheaper than ASML based on its Forward P/E , which tracks price against earnings estimates, and its P/S ratio measuring sales over the past twelve months.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

Although both companies are extraordinary, ASML is the clear winner here. Its position in the semiconductor industry is unlike almost anything else in the market: It is the only company in the world that makes the EUV machines needed to produce the most advanced chips. Every chipmaker racing to build AI hardware, from TSMC to Samsung to Intel, depends on ASML's equipment to do it. That kind of monopoly position is extraordinarily rare.

The most recent quarter backed that up convincingly. Revenue grew more than 20% year over year, the company raised its full-year outlook substantially, and AI-driven demand for advanced logic and memory chips keeps pulling orders forward.

Applied Materials is a strong business with broad exposure across chip manufacturing equipment. But it operates in a more competitive landscape where customers have alternatives. ASML has no real competition at the cutting edge of chip manufacturing. For investors thinking in years rather than quarters, owning that kind of irreplaceable position in the global technology supply chain is a straightforward long-term thesis.
